articles.summary: The Brandywine, a new boutique hotel on the Main Line, opens May 15, 2026, featuring elegant accommodations, dining, and modern amenities for all travelers.
articles.title: The Brandywine, the Main Line’s Newest Boutique Hotel, to Open May 15, 2026

articles.summary: Merrick’s Tavern at The Brandywine opens in May 2026, offering modern American fare, craft cocktails, and a welcoming Main Line dining experience.
articles.title: Merrick’s Tavern, the Main Line’s Newest Neighborhood Dining Destination, to Accept Reservations May 16, 2026

articles.summary: PHILADELPHIA, May 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brandywine Realty Trust (NYSE:BDN) announced today that its Board of Trustees has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per common share and OP Unit payable on Wednesday July 22, 2026 to holders of record on Wednesday, July 8, 2026.
articles.title: Brandywine Realty Trust Announces Common Quarterly Dividend, and Confirms Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
